finding: The Consequences of ADR-0034 say that a register file that HEAD holds is removed only when a finding file with the same ID replaces it, and that finding-lint rejects any other removal. DEC-65, BR-110, and _register_removable in finding-lint let a resolved or waived register file go. Fix: limit the sentence to an open register file and cite DEC-65.
why_this_severity: No story or code outside this run encodes the sentence, so in_use is false. The decision of the ADR still holds, and BR-110, the register-file contract, and the lint agree, so a reader who acts on the rule reaches the right result (no to fails_purpose). A reader of the ADR alone believes that a resolved register file cannot be removed and must open BR-110 to learn otherwise.
